::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Pune firm designing beamforming ASICs and electronically steered antennas. Its VAS7308 beamforming ASIC is described by the company as foundry-proven and in production (TRL 7). Government support verified: a Department of Telecommunications DCIS grant. Company website unavailable at last check (Nov 2026).
:::

## What does this firm design?

Beamforming ASICs (VAS7308) and electronically steered AESA/satcom antennas.
